description: Player 1 deck for spec 30 (R384, R510). This is spec 03 player 1 deck (03-plays-a) with #28 Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean swapped for C #81 The Power to Thrive, and #91 Fed Fauci swapped for C #21 Turtinator. Thrive costs 2 and Turtinator 2, and #8 Mr. Vanilla (1 mana, 4/4) is the Unit that pays Turtinator Tribute. Nothing else here has an Activate ability, a Trap, a Cast-on-draw or a Quickdraw, so the only Activate controls on the board are the two this spec asserts. Its seat plays under the handicap below, TUTORIAL_HUMAN's (R1705005): a human's resources with a deck of 20, the size every deck had before #1705, so these cards and the deal the spec's seed was tuned on stand. #5099: #8 Mr. Vanilla, #11 Tempo Timmy, #20 Pointmaster and #25 4-mana 7/7, a card whose whole text is its keyword line, are dealt as stand-ins (crates/engine/src/testkit/stand_in.rs) spelling their numbers as they stood, in the same place in the list, so the deal is unchanged and no balance patch moves them.
cards: stand-in (1) 3/3 Rush, First Strike R6/6 Charge, First Strike
